The attested content digest computed over the issued structured source MUST equal the digest recorded as reviewed. Generation, validation, retention or registration of a document MUST NOT be treated as attestation.

rules.text: With the Protected Preservation option, the issuance record and the preservation events MUST be protected against undetected alteration by an independent mechanism (an append-only log whose chain head is held by a party independent of the Repository, an electronic seal, or a trusted timestamp). rules.text: A Repository checks fixity without relying on transport metadata. It MUST compare each stored artefact with the SHA-256 digest recorded at issuance. It MUST record every check, including failures, as a preservation event. It MUST NOT alter or remove earlier events when doing so.

rules.text: legalAuthenticator MUST be populated only for an attested issuance whose attester is a person, and only from that attester. When the author is software, authorPerson MUST identify the software as an XCN software agent, and authorRole MUST NOT be used to describe it, because authorRole states the author's role in the documented act.
